title: UDS Probe
description: Reads engine/gearbox basics (rpm, speed, coolant, gear) purely over READ-ONLY diagnostics - no car-data SOME/IP, so it installs on any unit
_comment: Only the diagnostic transport (InternalTasu) is declared, marked _optional. It is present on this car (M Vitals / Fault Scanner use it). No car-data SOME/IP interfaces are declared, so this app bypasses the generateSomeIpInterfaces 'nothing found' failure entirely. Everything is read with READ-ONLY UDS (0x22) / OBD (0x01) via kit/readonly-diag.js.

com.harman.infotainment.systemfunctions.._optional: the diagnostic transport (read-only) - without it nothing can be read

settings.label: Save the report to a USB stick if present
